steps.title: Harvest cells to required biomass
steps.instruction: Collect the recommended biomass: 10 × 10⁶ mammalian cells, or an optical density equivalent of 6 for bacteria or yeast.

steps.title: Filter cells onto nylon filter
steps.instruction: Place a 47 mm nylon filter (0.2 µm pore) in a vacuum filtration assembly, apply vacuum, and dispense the harvested cells onto the filter. If desired, attach a 50 mL polypropylene tube to the sand‑core filter head outlet to collect the filtrate. Do not rinse the filter with fresh media or water to avoid membrane leakage and metabolite loss.

substeps.instruction: Set up vacuum filtration assembly with 47 mm nylon filter (0.2 µm).
Dispense cells onto filter under vacuum.
Optionally attach 50 mL polypropylene tube to collect supernatant.
Avoid any rinsing with media or water.

steps.title: Remove filter from vacuum assembly
steps.instruction: Turn off the vacuum and, using tweezers, carefully remove the nylon filter from the assembly.

steps.title: Transfer filter into conical tube
steps.instruction: Coil the removed filter and insert it into a 5 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Heat tube to denature metabolites
steps.instruction: Place the tube in heating blocks pre‑heated to 100 °C and incubate for 12 min; the liquid inside will not exceed 78 °C (the boiling point of ethanol).

steps.title: Quench metabolism in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Seal the tube tightly and submerge it in liquid nitrogen to instantly halt metabolic activity; keep the tube in liquid nitrogen until extraction proceeds.

steps.title: Add ethanol/formic acid extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Dispense 3 mL of a 75:25 (v/v) ethanol‑water solution containing 0.1 M formic acid into each sample tube.

steps.title: Collect extracellular filtrate for analysis
steps.instruction: Disassemble the filter‑flask assembly, remove the 50 mL conical tube, cap it, and store at 4 °C for immediate analysis or further extraction.

steps.title: Sonicate to homogenize extracts
steps.instruction: Probe‑sonicate the tubes until a homogeneous mixture is achieved.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins on ice
steps.instruction: Place the sonicated tubes in an ice bath for 60 min to precipitate proteins.

steps.title: Centrifuge extracts to clarify
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 min at 4000 rpm and 2 °C.

steps.title: Filter supernatant through 0.2 µm plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant in 1 mL fractions onto a PALL 0.2 µm GHP deep‑well filter plate that is attached to a 96‑well deep‑well receiving plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge filter plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter plate for 10 min at 4000 rpm and 2 °C.

steps.title: Evaporate to dryness
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a centrifugal evaporator and dry the samples at 30 °C until completely dry.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried extracts for analysis
steps.instruction: Immediately before analysis, re‑suspend and reconstitute all dried fractions into a single sample using 100 µL of a solvent compatible with the intended LC‑MS mobile phase.
